_comment: Canonical Go per-package mutation efficacy floors (percent). Single source of truth. Read directly by .github/scripts/gen_report_portal.py; api/Makefile and .github/workflows/nightly-mutation.yml mirror these values and are drift-guarded against this file by gen_report_portal_test.py (a mismatch fails CI). Technique shards aggregate into the single 'techniques' scope. transport/http is a dev-only harness (ARCH-2) and is not held to a production mutation floor.
